top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not conduct a fire drill for the month of August.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The most recent inspection form was not posted.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no documentation of fire safety emergency drills, fire extinguisher checks, smoke detector checks, and carbon monoxide detector testing made available for review during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include the information of indoor and outdoor physical activity.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram- Must Be On File (26 TAC §747.5007)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no emergency evacuation and relocation diagram available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Pet Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.801(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two cats and two dogs do not have up to date vaccinations.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training (26 TAC §747.801(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver has still not completed the required trainings for the last training year.
